report.root_cause: Between about 07:59:09 and 07:59:46 a burst of 338 minecarts was summoned through RCON (console log lines "[Rcon: Summoned new Minecart]" at 07:59:46). The entity count rose from 24 to 359. I could not identify the RCON client or the command that issued the summons: the logs show only the summon lines, and no plugin, script or deploy file in the server directory accounts for them. Server health was not visibly harmed: TPS stayed at 20 and MSPT peaked around 7 ms before settling near 4 ms.
report.actions: Checked server status and logs (latest.log, console.out, grep for RCON and TownCore) and the server directory (deploy/, plugins/, config/). Monitored TPS, MSPT, entity counts and heap over about 160 s. Did not declare an incident, did not delete or move any entities, did not ban anyone, and did not stop or restart the server. Made no file changes.
report.residual_risk: 338 minecarts remain loaded across 797 chunks with unknown origin and owner. Their count was stable at 359 total entities at the end of the shift. If they are unintended, they are a lag and grief risk and could be tick-heavy if they start moving or chunk-loading. The summons may have been a legitimate admin action; I did not confirm that with anyone, so I left them in place. Whoever has RCON access should confirm the source before any cleanup.
